main_measure.name: mean short-direction unusual 1-day move on bars with forecast <= -2

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day taken together

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with day-clustered t >= 2 (and supporting check passes); reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2; at least 100 case-days

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move, runs of 3+ (forecast <= -8) minus runs of 2 (-8 < forecast <= -2), above 0

decided_by: Mean short-direction unusual move above 0 with t >= 2 and longer runs show a larger move: the confirm rule.
reading: Situation from prices: close up on the bar and the previous close down (strict), using the regime column only on a window's first two bars; the next-day return stays inside the window and the coin's mean is over all its 1-bar returns in all windows; the day-clustered t sums deviations per UTC day with a G/(G-1) correction; case-days are distinct UTC days with a case; the shorter-run group is -8 < forecast <= -2.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.001763 on the check folds against +0.005931 on every fold
